channel.title: Journey Home
channel.desc: Roger came from a Fundamentalist Christian background and went on to become a Baptist pastor. When cracks in his "sola Scriptura" foundation began to appear, it shook his faith, and he wondered if Christianity was true at all. Through the help of a friend who started walking him through apologetics, he began to realize that "sola Scriptura" was not the only framework for understanding Christianity, and that the Catholic Church?s three-legged stool of Scripture, Tradition, and the Magisterium was how Jesus had set things up to begin with. (60 minutes).
